source_description_html:
The Shoei RF-SR Helmet takes every step possible to deliver a quiet, comfortable ride. The CWR-1 shield is held firmly against the eyeport using a constant tension sprung hinge design; this greatly reduces opportunities for wind ingress. The exterior shell of the RF-SR is wind tunnel optimized and manufactured in multiple sizes to keep the outer envelop as small as possible. A smaller exterior shell translates directly into less turbulence, neck strain and total weight. Elements of the padded liner are interchangeable to dial in the perfect fit. Each RF-SR is handmade in Japan to the highest standards and easily surpasses DOT and SNELL M2015 safety certifications.

Aerodynamic Shell Design:
  • Aerodynamic properties maximized through extensive wind tunnel and feedback from professional riders
  • Dual-Layer EPS liner enhances impact absorption and ventilation
  • Four shell and six EPS liner sizes increase fit options that help to comfortably fit most head sizes

    • Ventilation System:
  • Two upper air intake vents are positioned to maximize air volume into the helmet interior; hot air is exhausted through top outlet for a more comfortable ride
  • Lower intake vent absorbs air exhaled from the mouth to help eliminate shield fogging
  • Breath guard and chin curtain included

    • Lightweight Advanced Integrated Matrix Plus (AIM+):
  • High performance fiber materials are combined with extremely elastic organic fibers to create a shell structure that is ultra lightweight, rigid and resilient

    • Interior:
  • The entire interior lining (cheek pads, upper liner, and chin strap covers) can be removed for cleaning, center and cheek pads can be replaced with optional thicknesses for a customizable fit
  • E.Q.R.S. (Emergency Quick Release System) allows emergency medical personnel to easily remove the cheek pads from an injured rider’s helmet, enabling the helmet to be more easily removed from the head
  • Extra comfort provided by removable ear pads, breath guard, and chin curtain
  • Standard chin strap clip neatly secures chin strap

    • CWR-1 Shield and QR-E System:
  • CWR-1 shield features ribs along the top and bottom to improve rigidity and eliminate bending from wind pressure during opening and closing
  • Improved window beading features dual-layered dual lip construction that ensures a windproof and waterproof seal with every closure
  • Locking mechanism easily engages the shield lock when fully closed
  • Pinlock pins and EVO fog resistant lens insert included
  • Spring-loaded base plates offer quick shield changes
  • Five-stage rotating dial allows fine tuning of the base plate for easy shield adjustments
  • QR-E closure system allows for tool-less shield removal and installation, and provides an air-tight seal intended to significantly minimize wind noise

source_description_html:
• “X-Series”― SHOEI’s full face helmet for Racing developed through World’s Top Road Races including MotoGP.
  • All of shell, shield, interiors and aero device are renewed by realizing safety in high level and utilizing most advanced know-how obtained from race support in top category. “REAL RACING SPEC” is truly brought into shape, X-Fourteen, the full face helmet to win races.
  • Brand new SHOEI top-of-the-line model starts racing in the world.
  • Aero Form
  • Tear-off Film Attachable Flat Shield – CWR-F Shield
  • X-Fourteen is equipped with newly developed flat shield, “CWR-F”. 
  • Radius and thickness are finely decided in each area of the shield, and optical property is fully improved. CWR-F shield made of polycarbonate realizes a clear vision and advanced rigidity eliminating deflection and kink in high speed riding, Combination with QR-E shield base makes it easy to fix and remove a shield, and high airtightness is ensured in variable axis double action mechanism.
  • Interiors
  • Adjust Wearing Position of Interiors corresponding to Racing Position
  • The wearing position is different between upright riding position when riding on a standard bike and leaning forward position when riding on sport bike. Focusing on this point, the position of interiors of X-Fourteen can be adjusted in 2 steps depending on a riding position. By adjusting fixing position of center pad and cheek pad, the angle of rider’s head can be rotated forward by approximately 4 degrees from standard position, and as a result, it secures upper vision in leaning forward position. To ensure broader vision when leaning bikes in strongly leaning forward position gives riders great merit.
  • Study Racing Position,
  • Increase Aero Dynamic Performance in High Speed
  • X-Fourteen, developed putting much value on the use at circuits, sets the position where a rider strongly leans forward as basic position.
  • The shell is designed by analyzing the riding wind running from front part of a helmet to rear, and then to back of racing suit at the wind tunnel facility.
  • The edges and shapes on surface of a shell, rear stabilizer equipping rear flaps exchangeable depending upon riding condition and lower air spoiler are designed and equipped to maximally increase aerodynamic performance.
  • Comparing values in wind tunnel experiment with its predecessor, LIFT, DRAG and YAWING decreased by 3%, 10% and 50% respectively (value for reference measured by in-house facility). 
  • Greatly increased aerodynamic performance can do a lot to ease riders’ fatigue.
  • Shield System
  • E.Q.R.S.（Emergency Quick Release System）
  • Easy Helmet Removal System in case of an Accident
  • In an accident, it is difficult for a third party to remove a helmet from a rider.
  • Although impact-absorbing performance and comfort are essential for a helmet, to support a third party giving aid to a rider in an accident is one of the important functions of a helmet. E.Q.R.S. (Emergency Quick Release System) developed by SHOEI makes removing of a helmet easy minimizing a load on a rider’s neck where is possibly injured by pulling strip.
  • Ventilation System
  • Strongly introduce riding wind, exhaust hot air and moisture effectively―ventilation system makes a rider feels wind.
  • Air intakes are equipped on 2 parts of X-Fourteen, front and upper areas, in order to produce an effect of ventilation system even in leaning forward position.
  • Air outlet holes of top air outlet and inside of rear stabilizer exhaust hot air effectively using negative pressure.
  • In addition, new air route is equipped in lower part of a helmet, and air introduced to lower air intake is divided in 2 ways. 
  • Upper part of a lower air intake leads air to inside of a shield and works as a defroster, and lower part of it leads air to cheek area where hot air and moisture may remain.
  • AIM+ shell structure which is of complex layers of strong glass fiber and high performance organic fiber in high elasticity satisfies requirements of the safety standards easily. 
  • In addition to JIS, X-Fourteen is SNELL 2015 certified.

name: Shoei Photochromic Visor (CWR-F2PN)
description: With a photochromic visors you are well-prepared for all light situations.
source_description_html:
With a photochromic visors you are well-prepared for all light situations.

It dynamically adapts to changing light conditions.

The visor of your helmet protects you against many, what comes up to you whilst motorcycling, like wind, rain, insects or dust. A careful maintenance prolongs its usage period.

If your visor is dirty, clean it carefully, as explained in the manual of your helmet or visor. If it is scratched or damaged, you should replace it as soon as possible, to avoid dangerous situations or an accident.

A PINLOCK EVO mist-retardant lens can be retrofitted in all current full-face helmet visors from SHOEI. This provides you with a clear view in a major part of the field of vision, even at difficult weather conditions.

Only use visors suitable for your helmet model from the SHOEI spare parts range.

Vortex-generators on the side edges of the visor contribute to reducing the drag of the helmet and the noise pollution of the driver.

With the centrally mounted visor-tab the visor can be opened and closed without torsion.

SHOEI's quick-change mechanism allows the visor to be removed and installed tool-free in seconds.

A manual with explanations for assembly and maintenance comes included with the visor.

The Shoei NXR is currently one of the most wanted Shoei helmets on the market. It is truly a helmet Shoei takes pride in. That’s why they have renewed the helmet and come up with the NXR II, a refined helmet polished to the needs of a rider.

With the release of the NXR II, comes the slogan “the evolution of perfection”. Shoei constantly thrives to evolve and put the finest products on the market. With the NXR II, the most advanced techniques and technology have been incorporated. The best features of the helmet are a new wind channel system, the wide range of patented materials, and the strict quality assurance practices.

The Shoei NXR II, also known as the RF-1400, has significantly improved aerodynamics and noise reduction. Shoei establishes this by fine-tuning their wind channels system. The NXR II is shaped to reduce wind resistance, putting less pressure on the head and neck.

The wind channels are renewed for improved ventilation and noise reduction. With Shoei helmets already having the most silent helmets, the new NXR II is a true game changer.

The helmet is also improved when it comes to safety. The interior has improved shock absorption and shock distribution. The helmet is designed with a smaller shell size and the absence of a sun visor allows the shell size to be even smaller. A small shell size allows the helmet to be more lightweight, making it feel more natural. The wide CWR-F2 visor provides extended visibility while riding.

source_description_html:
The Shoei NXR is currently one of the most wanted Shoei helmets on the market. It is truly a helmet Shoei takes pride in. That’s why they have renewed the helmet and come up with the NXR II, a refined helmet polished to the needs of a rider.

With the release of the NXR II, comes the slogan “the evolution of perfection”. Shoei constantly thrives to evolve and put the finest products on the market. With the NXR II, the most advanced techniques and technology have been incorporated. The best features of the helmet are a new wind channel system, the wide range of patented materials, and the strict quality assurance practices.

The Shoei NXR II, also known as the RF-1400, has significantly improved aerodynamics and noise reduction. Shoei establishes this by fine-tuning their wind channels system. The NXR II is shaped to reduce wind resistance, putting less pressure on the head and neck.

The wind channels are renewed for improved ventilation and noise reduction. With Shoei helmets already having the most silent helmets, the new NXR II is a true game changer.

The helmet is also improved when it comes to safety. The interior has improved shock absorption and shock distribution. The helmet is designed with a smaller shell size and the absence of a sun visor allows the shell size to be even smaller. A small shell size allows the helmet to be more lightweight, making it feel more natural. The wide CWR-F2 visor provides extended visibility while riding.

  • Integrated spoiler

description: The whole is always more than the sum of its parts. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
NXR2: Pureness refined.
Sporty street helmet.
The whole is always more than the sum of its parts.
It is our decades of experience in premium helmet construction, our uncompromisingly high quality of workmanship and our research-based view of the demands of the motorcyclists of today and tomorrow that make a premium sports helmet out of the components of comfortable fit, highly efficient ventilation, proven aerodynamics, reliable safety and maximum wearing comfort.
The compact and lightweight SHOEI NXR2 premium sports helmet.
Its AIM (Advanced Integrated Matrix) outer shell, combined with a polystyrene core system composed of several elements of different absorption capacity, provides optimum impact protection.
The CWR-F2 visor, newly developed for the SHOEI NXR2, with two-dimensional shaping, enables distortion-free and very natural vision. Reinforcements at the upper and lower edge of the visor increase torsional stiffness, and a locking mechanism now located in the center prevents the visor from opening unintentionally. The visor can be changed and adjusted quickly and tool-free thanks to a further developed mechanism of the predecessor model.
The enlarged, mist-retardant PINLOCK®EVO lens included with the helmet allows a clear view over a large part of the usable field of vision, even in difficult weather conditions, thanks to the mounting pins that are set far to the rear.
The chin strap with double-D closure is easily adjustable and holds the helmet safely in place.
In an emergency, the cheek pads can be easily removed for gentle helmet removal thanks to the EQRS system (Emergency Quick Release System).
4 different outer shell sizes (XXS-S | M | L | XL-XXL) make the NXR2 a compact, lightweight sports helmet with a wide range of sizes. Its low weight relieves the neck muscles and thus reduces the fatigue effect, whether in sporting use on the race track or on extended tours.
The three-dimensionally contoured center pad, the pre-shaped cheek pads and the chin strap cover are completely removable and washable. Lightly roughened but soft, quick-drying cover materials reduce the friction of the pads on the skin and ensure a comfortable feeling. The newly designed cheek pads make it easier to put the helmet on and take it off. Thanks to their more voluminous underside, they reduce noise exposure for the rider. Head and cheek pads are available in different thicknesses for individual adjustment of the helmet.
Removable pads in the ear area contribute effectively to noise reduction.
Recesses in the ear area allow an intercom system to be attached.
The 6 air inlets and 4 air outlets of the SHOEI NXR2 are connected via a branched ventilation system inside the helmet shell and noticeably reduce the temperature and humidity inside the helmet. They always ensure a sufficient supply of fresh air for the rider without increasing the noise level. The result is a pleasant interior helmet climate for a concentrated and fatigue-free ride, both during sporty riding on the racetrack and on motorbike trips to warm countries.
The shutter slides of the ventilation inlets are easy to adjust even when wearing gloves.
Aerodynamics
The integrated spoiler in the back of the head stabilises the helmet at higher speeds. The compact and aerodynamically optimised design of the SHOEI NXR2 reduces its wind resistance and lift tendency even further compared to the already low values of the predecessor model. This effectively relieves the rider's neck muscles and reduces the fatigue effect even on longer rides.
Vortex generators on the edges of the visor and a newly developed visor beading minimise noise generation in the area of the visor.
Visors in a variety of different tints and mirror coatings are available for the SHOEI NXR2 and can be used under consideration of the ECE homologation regulations. The helmet is equipped with a clear CWR-F2 visor as standard, which is available even in a photochromatic (self-tinting) version. All visors of this type can be fitted with mist-retardant PINLOCK®EVO lenses, one of which is included with the helmet.
In the range of SHOEI accessories, cheek pads and center pads are available in different sizes and thicknesses to replace the original pads or to individually adjust the helmet. Also available are a chin strap pad, a Breath Guard and a Chin Curtain.
The SHOEI NXR2 comes with a PINLOCK®EVO lens for use with the standard CWR-F2 visor and replacement pins.
Also included are a Breath Guard, a Chin Curtain, SHOEI logo stickers, an original SHOEI helmet bag for careful storage of the helmet and a silicone oil for maintaining the visor seal and mechanism.
The handbook of the helmet, as well as the brochure “How to use your helmet properly” provides useful instructions for use, maintenance and care of your SHOEI NXR2.

Features:

• Helmet shell made of AIM+: "Organic Fiber", "Multifiber" and "High Performance Organic Fiber" in different layers for shock-absorbing shell with optimal stiffness.

• Multi-part, modular polystyrene core system: optimum protection through polystyrene core elements with different degrees of damping

• Fog-resistant CWR-F2 Pinlock visor: 2-dimensional design

• Double-D closure: easy handling / always perfectly adjusted

• E.Q.R.S. safety system: Emergency Quick Release System / simplifies helmet removal in case of emergency

• 4 different sized helmet outer shells: for optimal fit and most compact size

• Removable and washable 3D moulded cheek pads: for optimal fit and easy cleaning

• removable and washable modular centre pad: for individual fit as well as easy cleaning

• removable and washable chin strap cover: for better care

• new cheek ventilation system: active ventilation in the lower part of the helmet

• integrated spoiler

• prepared for intercom

• compact, progressive shape

• light and resistant

• effective noise reduction

• multiple ventilation, 6 inlets on forehead and chin, 4 outlets on back of head and neck

• frontal closure mechanism with quick and easy handling

• optimised Pinlock position, out of field of vision

• developed in Shoei's wind tunnel

• reduction of lift by 6 % compared to the NXR

• minimisation of drag by 4 % compared to the NXR

• Shoei's padding system allows for a perfect fit as each component is selectable in optimal size

• Sizes: XXS - XXL

• Helmet shell sizes: 4 (XXS - S, M, L, XL - XXL)

• Closure: Double-D

• Visor type: CWR-F2 Pinlock prepared

• Weight: 1390 g (+/- 50 g)

• ECE 22.06

• 1 x Shoei NXR 2 Origami helmet

• 1 x Pinlock visor

• 1 x Breath deflector

• 1 x Wind deflector

source_description_html:
The Shoei NXR is currently one of the most wanted Shoei helmets on the market. It is truly a helmet Shoei takes pride in. That’s why they have renewed the helmet and come up with the NXR II, a refined helmet polished to the needs of a rider.

With the release of the NXR II, comes the slogan “the evolution of perfection”. Shoei constantly thrives to evolve and put the finest products on the market. With the NXR II, the most advanced techniques and technology have been incorporated. The best features of the helmet are a new wind channel system, the wide range of patented materials, and the strict quality assurance practices.

The Shoei NXR II, also known as the RF-1400, has significantly improved aerodynamics and noise reduction. Shoei establishes this by fine-tuning their wind channels system. The NXR II is shaped to reduce wind resistance, putting less pressure on the head and neck.

The wind channels are renewed for improved ventilation and noise reduction. With Shoei helmets already having the most silent helmets, the new NXR II is a true game changer.

The helmet is also improved when it comes to safety. The interior has improved shock absorption and shock distribution. The helmet is designed with a smaller shell size and the absence of a sun visor allows the shell size to be even smaller. A small shell size allows the helmet to be more lightweight, making it feel more natural. The wide CWR-F2 visor provides extended visibility while riding.

Outer shell:
  • AIM multi-ply matrix composite fibre
  • 4 shell sizes (XXS-S / M / L / XL-XXL)
  • Integrated spoiler

    • Protection:
  • EPS inner shell available in 7 sizes
  • Multiple density inner shell for optimal shock absorption
  • Double-D chin strap
  • EQRS emergency removal chin pieces
  • ECE certified

    • Ventilation:
  • Multiple ventilation for maximum comfort
  • Chin and forehead intake
  • Four outlets on the rear to let out warm air

    • Comfort:
  • 3D Max Dry custom interior system II
  • Fully removable and washable lining
  • Noise reducing earpads

    • Visor:
  • Thermoplastic aerodynamic shaped CWR-1 visor
  • Minimal impact riding wind
  • Minimal sight manipulation
  • Pinlock anti fog lens included

source_description_html:
The Shoei NXR is currently one of the most wanted Shoei helmets on the market. It is truly a helmet Shoei takes pride in. That’s why they have renewed the helmet and come up with the NXR II, a refined helmet polished to the needs of a rider.

With the release of the NXR II, comes the slogan “the evolution of perfection”. Shoei constantly thrives to evolve and put the finest products on the market. With the NXR II, the most advanced techniques and technology have been incorporated. The best features of the helmet are a new wind channel system, the wide range of patented materials, and the strict quality assurance practices.

The Shoei NXR II, also known as the RF-1400, has significantly improved aerodynamics and noise reduction. Shoei establishes this by fine-tuning their wind channels system. The NXR II is shaped to reduce wind resistance, putting less pressure on the head and neck.

The wind channels are renewed for improved ventilation and noise reduction. With Shoei helmets already having the most silent helmets, the new NXR II is a true game changer.

The helmet is also improved when it comes to safety. The interior has improved shock absorption and shock distribution. The helmet is designed with a smaller shell size and the absence of a sun visor allows the shell size to be even smaller. A small shell size allows the helmet to be more lightweight, making it feel more natural. The wide CWR-F2 visor provides extended visibility while riding.

  • Integrated spoiler

The NXR 2 combines the essential features of a sporty road helmet. Safe & powerful. Shoei's entire knowledge of advanced helmet development is concentrated in this helmet. Experience the pure performance!

Features:

  • Helmet shell made of AIM+: "Organic Fiber", "Multifiber" and "High Performance Organic Fiber" in different layers for shock-absorbing shell with optimal stiffness.
  • Multi-part, modular polystyrene core system: optimum protection through polystyrene core elements with different degrees of damping
  • Fog-resistant CWR-F2 Pinlock visor: 2-dimensional design
  • Double-D closure: easy handling / always perfectly adjusted
  • E.Q.R.S. safety system: Emergency Quick Release System / simplifies helmet removal in case of emergency

  • Removable and washable 3D moulded cheek pads: for optimal fit and easy cleaning
  • removable and washable modular centre pad: for individual fit as well as easy cleaning
  • removable and washable chin strap cover: for better care
  • new cheek ventilation system: active ventilation in the lower part of the helmet
  • integrated spoiler
  • prepared for intercom
  • compact, progressive shape
  • light and resistant
  • effective noise reduction
  • multiple ventilation, 6 inlets on forehead and chin, 4 outlets on back of head and neck
  • frontal closure mechanism with quick and easy handling
  • optimised Pinlock position, out of field of vision
  • developed in Shoei's wind tunnel
  • reduction of lift by 6 % compared to the NXR
  • minimisation of drag by 4 % compared to the NXR
